<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def mblocks(fr):
    out=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='M' and n['boundary'][0][0]>10:
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            out.append((min(rs),min(cs)))
    return sorted(out)
print('before', mblocks(current_frame))
# timer bottom bar
a=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
print('timer row63:', a[63][:64].count('W'),'W of',len(a[63]))
# calibration click: up-right of B1(36,17), toward ball left edge
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':33,'col':20}])
print('after t+1', mblocks(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def mblocks(fr):
    out=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='M' and n['boundary'][0][0]>10:
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            out.append((min(rs),min(cs)))
    return sorted(out)
